title: m5stack/CardputerZeroRepository #2: beaconhound 0.1.0 arm64 .deb is well formed, but hard-codes the pi account and grants no scan capability

execution.environment: macOS arm64; package unpacked with ar/tar, inspected with llvm-readelf/llvm-objdump and strings; dpkg-deb unavailable; no Linux arm64 runtime

checks.name: deb_structure
checks.evidence: ar members debian-binary(2.0), control.tar.gz, data.tar.gz; gzip -t passes for both; evidence/deb-metadata.txt

checks.name: control_metadata
checks.evidence: Package beaconhound, Version 0.1.0, Architecture arm64, Depends iw, wireless-regdb, libc6 (>= 2.34); filename matches <pkg>_<version>_arm64.deb; evidence/deb-metadata.txt

checks.name: payload_md5sums
checks.evidence: all 7 DEBIAN/md5sums entries match the extracted payload

checks.name: elf_arch_and_deps
checks.evidence: both binaries AArch64 PIE, interpreter /lib/ld-linux-aarch64.so.1, NEEDED libc.so.6 only, max symbol GLIBC_2.34, no RPATH/RUNPATH; evidence/elf-dynamic.txt

checks.name: maintainer_script_syntax
checks.evidence: sh -n passes for postinst and prerm; scripts only act on configure/remove/deconfigure; evidence/service-and-scripts.txt

checks.name: service_hardcoded_pi_user
checks.evidence: unit lines 7-8 User=pi/Group=pi; postinst line 7 enables only if 'id -u pi' succeeds; docs say the username is chosen in the first-boot wizard

checks.name: socket_accessible_to_desktop_user
checks.evidence: socket chmod mode immediate 0x1b0 = 0660, RuntimeDirectory owned by User=pi; a UI running as a different account cannot connect

checks.name: scan_capability
checks.evidence: static: daemon execs iw dev <iface> scan dump; unit has NoNewPrivileges=true and no AmbientCapabilities; nl80211 trigger scan requires CAP_NET_ADMIN (not executed)

checks.name: ci_validation
checks.evidence: validate-submission run 44433521771 conclusion=action_required, 0 s, no jobs; no dpkg-deb log

checks.name: hardware_validation
checks.evidence: no CardputerZero on the hardware bench; test center exposes ESP32 slots only

checks.name: virtual_device_validation
checks.evidence: Device Service cardputer-zero profile supported=false creatable=false, missing __missing_qemu__/__missing_rom__, reason 'CardputerZero uses a separate Linux backend'

checks.name: install_and_execute
checks.evidence: no arm64 Linux userland available; Docker metadata store unwritable and ~4 GiB free

evidence.description: ar layout, control, payload list, md5sums comparison, hashes
ELF class/machine/interpreter, NEEDED, GLIBC symbol version
unit file, postinst, prerm, sh -n, desktop entry
iw argv strings, execv fallbacks, socket chmod mode
action_required validate run and recent workflow runs
Device Service cardputer-zero profile and hardware bench summary

notes: Evidence class is code-level verification; the package was not installed and neither binary was executed.
F2 (CAP_NET_ADMIN) is an expected-failure inference from the unit and call path, not an observed EPERM.
Review comment only; no change was pushed to the PR or the fork and the PR was not closed.
